items.name: StringLike
items.summary: An enum that holds a reference to a string-like expression from the AST. This includes string literals, bytes literals, f-strings, and t-strings.

methods.name: is_implicit_concatenated
methods.summary: Returns `true` if the string is implicitly concatenated.

methods.name: parts
methods.summary: Returns an iterator over the [`StringLikePart`] contained in this string-like expression.

items.name: StringLikePart
items.summary: An enum that holds a reference to an individual part of a string-like expression.

methods.name: content_range
methods.summary: Returns the range of the string's content in the source (minus prefix and quotes).

methods.name: flags
methods.summary: Returns the [`AnyStringFlags`] for the current string-like part.

items.name: StringLikePartIter
items.summary: An iterator over all the [`StringLikePart`] of a string-like expression.
